function_comments.0x00602B90:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:jinit_c_prep_controller matched): Initializes the compression preprocessing controller. need_full_buffer != 0 raises error 4. function_comments.0x00602C90:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:start_pass_prep matched): Accepts only JBUF_PASS_THRU (0); other modes raise error 4. function_comments.0x00602D00:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:pre_process_data matched): Seven-argument preprocessing callback. Converts input rows into the color buffer, updating input count, next_buf_row and rows_to_go. Each full max_v group is downsampled into the next output row group. At image end, repeats the final converted row to complete a group, then repeats the last output row per component to fill the requested output group capacity. Row counts are integers; the old pointer inference in the padding helper was incorrect.
function_comments.0x00602F20:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:expand_bottom_edge matched): void(rowPointerArray, unsigned numCols, int inputRows, int outputRows). Copies numCols bytes from the LAST ORIGINAL row (inputRows-1) into each row inputRows..outputRows-1 using jcopy_sample_rows. No action when inputRows >= outputRows. No inputRows > 0 or capacity check. The third argument is an integer row count, not void **.
function_comments.0x00602F70:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:pre_process_context matched): Context preprocessing callback using a ring of 3*max_v actual rows plus aliased pointer margins. Initially fills two groups, replicating the first row into negative context indices. At image end, repeats the last row to the next stop. Downsamples this_row_group when ready, advances by max_v and wraps at 3*max_v. If input ends before the image is complete, returns to await more input. Provides the neighboring rows required by smoothing.
function_comments.0x006031E0:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcprepct.c:create_context_buffer matched): Allocates 5*max_v row pointers per component and 3*max_v actual sample rows. Middle pointer groups address the actual rows; the leading group aliases the last actual group and the trailing group aliases the first. Stores a pointer shifted past the leading margin, permitting negative context row indices. Sample width is max_h*8*width_in_blocks/h_samp. Pixels are initialized later by preprocessing.
function_comments.0x00603330:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:jinit_downsampler matched): Initializes the 52-byte downsampler at cinfo+352. Method pointers begin at +12; +8 is need_context_rows. CCIR601_sampling raises error 25. Chooses full-size, h2v1, h2v2, or generic integer-ratio methods; fractional ratios raise error 38. Smoothing selects the full-size or h2v2 smooth method and requests context rows. Unsupported smoothing for other ratios retains the ordinary method and emits trace 99 at level 0; supported components may still be smoothed.
function_comments.0x00603570:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:start_pass_downsample matched): No-op start-pass callback with one unused cdecl cinfo argument. The old no-argument inferred prototype omitted this callback ABI argument.
function_comments.0x00603580:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:sep_downsample matched): Dispatches each component to its selected downsampling method: (cinfo, component, inputRows[i]+inRowIndex, outputRows[i]+outRowGroupIndex*v_samp). Component records have an 84-byte stride. Row pointer offsets are scaled by four bytes.
function_comments.0x00603620:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:int_downsample matched): Generic integer box downsampling. hExpand=max_h/h_samp, vExpand=max_v/v_samp, outputWidth=8*width_in_blocks. Pads the INPUT right edge to hExpand*outputWidth. Each output sample is (sum + area/2)/area over hExpand*vExpand pixels. Initializer guarantees positive integral sampling ratios.
function_comments.0x00603790:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:expand_right_edge matched): For each of numRows, repeats the byte at inputCols-1 into columns inputCols..outputCols-1. Nonpositive extension does nothing. Does not validate inputCols > 0 or destination capacity. Callers may use it on input or output rows.
function_comments.0x00603810:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:fullsize_downsample matched): Copies max_v rows of image_width bytes to output, then pads the OUTPUT right edge to 8*width_in_blocks. Selected when component sampling equals the maximum in both axes. Does not modify input padding.
function_comments.0x00603870:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:h2v1_downsample matched): Horizontal 2:1 downsampling. Pads INPUT rows to twice the output width, then computes (a+b+bias)>>1 for each pixel pair. Bias alternates 0/1 across columns and resets to zero each row. No vertical averaging or smoothing.
function_comments.0x00603940:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:h2v2_downsample matched): Horizontal and vertical 2:1 downsampling. Pads INPUT rows to twice the output width; each output is the average of a 2x2 block using (sum+bias)>>2. Bias alternates 1/2 across columns and resets to one each output row.
function_comments.0x00603A50:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:h2v2_smooth_downsample matched): Integrated 2x2 downsampling and smoothing. Requires one context row above and below; right-pads rows -1..max_v to twice output width. With S=smoothing_factor, each central 2x2 pixel has weight 16384-80*S, four outer corner pixels have weight 16*S, and eight outer edge pixels have weight 32*S. Adds 32768 and shifts by 16 into a byte. Horizontal edges are replicated. No explicit S clamp.
function_comments.0x00603DE0:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jcsample.c:fullsize_smooth_downsample matched): Full-size 3x3 smoothing. Requires one context row above and below and pads their right edges. Center weight is 65536-512*S; each of eight neighbors has weight 64*S. Adds 32768 and shifts by 16 into a byte. Uses rolling column sums and replicates horizontal edges. Does not downsample or explicitly clamp S.
function_comments.0x00604020:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jccolor.c:jinit_color_converter matched): Initializes the 12-byte color converter at cinfo+348. Validates input component count (error 9) and output count (error 10). Gray output accepts gray/YCbCr by copying the first channel or RGB through luminance tables. RGB and CMYK output require matching input. YCbCr accepts RGB conversion or matching YCbCr; YCCK accepts CMYK conversion or matching YCCK. Other enums require exact input/output enum and count agreement. Unsupported conversions raise error 27. Matching formats use deinterleaving, not a no-op.
function_comments.0x006043E0:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jccolor.c:rgb_ycc_start matched): Allocates eight 256-entry int32 tables (8192 bytes) in pool 1; converter+8 points to them. For i=0..255: RY=19595*i, GY=38470*i, BY=7471*i+32768, RCb=-11059*i, GCb=-21709*i, shared BCb/RCr=32768*i+0x807FFF, GCr=-27439*i, BCr=-5329*i. Chroma bias is (128<<16)+32767; the half-minus-one rounding prevents a maximum value of 256.
function_comments.0x00604500:0: UNREALRED VERIFIED (2026-10-29; original PE bytes and fresh disassembly; IJG v6b jccolor.c:rgb_ycc_convert matched): Five-argument color callback (cinfo, inputRows, outputPlanes, outputRow, numRows).
